AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.
CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Commission at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Planning Commission is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  FEBRUARY 18, 2020

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  February 18, 2020
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present:  Wade, Criley, Roos, Walker, Lazarro present as of 7:44 p.m.
Absent:  Lazzaro until 7:44 p.m.
Also present: Acting City Manager, Community Development & Public Works Director, & City Engineer
  Ken Rukavina
  Planning Manager Brianna Rindge
  Planner Maddie Bright
  Assistant City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

  Speakers: None

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  CDP-117-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1166); Consideration of a Coastal Development
  Permit Application for replacement of a storm drain outfall structure on City-owned property at the
  bottom of the cliff at the beach in Christmas Cove located southeast of 2841 Via Segovia. APN#
  7542-031-900. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title
  14, Chapter 3, Section 15302.

  Applicant/Owner: City of Palos Verdes Estates

  Action: Wade moved and Walker seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor; Lazzaro absent)
  with standard conditions.

2.  NC-1653-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1165); Consideration of a Neighborhood
  Compatibility Application for additions to an existing single-family residence located at 613 Via
  Del Monte. Lot 4 & part of Lot 5, Block 1615, Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Brad Dudley, 345 Third St, Laguna Beach, CA 92651
  Owner: Corey & Susan Moore

  Action: Wade moved and Walker seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor; Lazzaro absent)
  with standard conditions.
Action Minutes  Page 1 of 3
February 18, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
 3.  M-1367-20 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2020-1167); Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application
  for walls exceeding 3.5’ in a setback adjacent to a street and nonstandard encroachments within City
  right-of-way at the single-family residence located at 640 Via Del Monte. Lot 11, Block 1516,
  Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title
  14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Miles Pritzkat, 306 Vista Del Mar A, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
  Owner: Michael & Gemma Kemps

  Action: Walker moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor; Lazzaro absent)
  with standard conditions and the following conditions: 1) The nonstandard encroachments within the
  City right-of-way may remain exactly as shown on the approved site plan as it pertains to the retaining
  walls, stairs to the front door, and driveway along with the execution of a license agreement. The
  license agreement shall stipulate that a minimum 6-foot set back from the curb be maintained with any
  future modification of retaining walls; and 2) The trash enclosure design shall match that of the garage.

OLD BUSINESS

4.  NC-1665-19, G-1634-19 & M-1358-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1160); Consideration of
  Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single-family
  residence located at 2220 Via La Brea. Lot 10, Block 1651, Tract 7330. This project is exempt
  from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Tomaro Architecture, 2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
  Owner: Garrett & Janet Stearns

  Speakers: William Lyons, Tom Bechler, Nasreen Pathawala, Morgan Tam, Julia Tam, David
  Kelliny

  Action: Public hearing continued to a future meeting.

5.  Ordinance No. 020-743 repealing Section 17.08.170 (Dwelling Unit, Second) of Chapter 17.08
  (Definitions) of Title 17 (Zoning Procedures), amending Chapters 18.04 (R-1 Zone) and 18.08 (R-
  M Zone) of Title 18 (Zoning Regulations), and adding Chapter 18.45 (Accessory Dwelling Units)
  in the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code.

  Speakers: Janine Nendick, Marlene Breen, Tom Bechler

  Action: Lazzaro moved and Criley seconded to recommend to the City Council adoption of the
  ordinance regulating Accessory Dwelling Units (5-0 in favor) with the following changes: 1)
  Remove the previously proposed regulations regarding lot coverage [18.45.060(C)], requiring
  parking required for public safety [18.45.060(G)(4)], and discretionary portion of landscape review
  [18.45.060(I)(3)]; 2) Change the minimum parking requirement from one parking space per
  bedroom to one parking space per unit; 3) Instill a maximum bedroom allowance of one bedroom
  per unit; 4) Add regulations for cut within the grading regulations [18.45.060(J)].

NEW BUSINESS

6.  Discussion of Cellars and Basements.
Action Minutes  Page 2 of 3
February 18, 2020 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   Speakers: Janine Nendick, Marlene Breen

  Action: Continued to a future meeting.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

7.  Administrative Approvals – Reviewed and filed.

8.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

9.  Meeting of January 21, 2019.

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to receive and file (5-0 in favor).

Adjourned at 10:11 p.m.

Adjourn to the Planning Commission meeting on Tuesday, March 17, 2020 at 6:30 p.m.

This Planning Commission meeting may be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City
website at www.pvestates.org.
